about: Eventions Limited (formerly Eventions Private Limited, incorporated December 2020, Gurugram) is an asset-light MICE and corporate event management company that plans and executes meetings, incentive trips, conferences and brand activations for corporate clients in India and abroad. It executed 200+ events over FY24-FY26, 107 of them above Rs 50 lakh ticket size. In March 2026 it acquired 70% of Gantu Online Pvt Ltd, a B2C travel (FIT) platform.

other.name: Events with contract value Rs 50 lakh+

objects.purpose: Investment in subsidiary (Gantu Online Pvt Ltd, as debt, for technology platform)
General corporate purposes (capped at lower of 15% of gross proceeds or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Cristoo Arora and Ravi Rajak are the founding directors and also promoters of subsidiary Gantu Online; promoters and promoter group hold 89,49,909 shares pre-issue (99.96%).

concentration.note: FY26: top 1 customer 42.72%, top 3 54.40%, top 5 64.57%, top 10 84.59% of revenue (FY25 top 10 was 96.67%). MICE is 91.29% of revenue; 71.15% of revenue billed from Haryana.

litigation_note: No criminal cases. Company: 6 tax proceedings aggregating Rs 83.03 lakh and 1 civil matter against it; promoters: 10 tax proceedings of Rs 188.11 lakh; subsidiary: 1 tax proceeding of Rs 2.44 lakh. Also past late ROC filings and a Section 10A adjudication application filed March 2026.
strengths: Integrated MICE and corporate event model: 200+ events executed over FY24-FY26, 107 of them above Rs 50 lakh ticket size.
Asset-light model run through hospitality, logistics and production partners, keeping fixed costs low.
Executes both domestic and international programs; events above Rs 50 lakh grew from 27 in FY24 to 49 in FY26.
Revenue grew from Rs 86.57 crore (FY24) to Rs 99.74 crore (FY26) while PAT rose from Rs 3.29 crore to Rs 7.72 crore.
EBITDA margin improved from 4.77% to 10.22% between FY24 and FY26.
Repeat business from corporate clients; top-1 customer dependence fell from 63.21% to 42.72%.
Founders have run the business since 2020; promoters will still hold about 73.46% after the issue.

risks.title: Heavy customer concentration
risks.detail: In FY26 the top customer gave 42.72% of revenue and the top 10 gave 84.59% (96.67% in FY25). Losing one big client would hit revenue sharply.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was Rs -4.52 crore in FY26 and Rs -2.89 crore in FY25 despite reported profits; trade receivables tripled to Rs 29.87 crore in FY26 from Rs 9.86 crore.

risks.title: Rising debt at high interest rates
risks.detail: Borrowings grew from Rs 2.01 crore (FY24) to Rs 9.44 crore (FY26), including unsecured loans at up to 19%; promoter personal guarantees and director property back some facilities.

risks.title: Dependence on MICE segment
risks.detail: MICE services were 91.29% of FY26 revenue (91.77% in FY25). A downturn in corporate travel and event budgets would hurt earnings.

risks.title: Related-party dealings and promoter loans
risks.detail: Promoter Cristoo Arora received Rs 87 lakh and repaid Rs 213.68 lakh of loans in FY26; large imprest and expense reimbursements (Rs 283.10 lakh, Rs 94.93 lakh to Gantu) were also booked with related parties.

risks.title: Geographic concentration
risks.detail: 71.15% of FY26 revenue was billed in Haryana (68.93% in FY25), though billing location may differ from event location.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance lapses and litigation
risks.detail: Multiple late ROC filings (up to 429 days), a Section 10A adjudication filed March 2026, and 6 tax proceedings against the company (Rs 83.03 lakh) plus 10 against promoters (Rs 188.11 lakh).

risks.title: Young company, new acquisition and unappraised use of funds
risks.detail: Operating since December 2020; 70% of loss-making Gantu Online bought in March 2026 (Gantu lost Rs 0.75 crore in FY26). About Rs 18.80 crore of the issue goes to working capital based on management estimates, not independently appraised.

notes: Figures are Restated Standalone (Eventions Limited) for FY24-FY26 converted from Rs lakh to Rs crore; an unaudited proforma consolidated statement including 70% of Gantu Online (acquired March 2026) is also shown in the RHP and was ignored. Price band, issue size in Rs and P/E are blank in the RHP. Total assets/cash are rounded from lakh figures. Ratios (ROCE, RoNW, ROE, debt/equity as % converted to ratio, PAT margin on total income) are as reported; ROE here uses closing net worth per KPI table. Pre-issue holding 99.96% is promoters plus promoter group. Issue includes 1,62,000 market maker shares; post-issue shares computed as 89,53,509 + 32,30,400. Peer revenue converted from lakh.
